subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the maximum and minimum values of f(x) = cos(x + π/3) + 2√2 sin(x + π/3) − 3 over ℝ.

mark_split.label: Substitute θ = x + π/3 and find √(a² + b²)
Apply the maximum and minimum formulas

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — name the formula you use and how you finish.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Substitute θ = x + π/3 and find √(a² + b²)
steps.margin_note: First mark. The shift inside the angle changes nothing: as x takes every real value, so does x + π/3. Square 2√2 carefully — it is 8.
steps.memory_tip: A shift inside the angle never changes the maximum. Square 2√2 as 4 × 2 = 8, so √(1 + 8) = 3.
lines: Let θ = x + π/3. As x takes every real
Compare with a cos θ + b sin θ + c:

recall.must_convey: That θ = x + π/3 still takes every real value, and with a = 1, b = 2√2, c = −3 the root √(a² + b²) is 3.
accept: put theta equal to x plus pi by three and the shift changes nothing
a is one, b is two root two and c is minus three
two root two squared is eight so root one plus eight is three
theta ga substitute chesi, root nine ante three
the root of a squared plus b squared is three

steps.why: The maximum of a cos θ + b sin θ depends only on a and b, and θ = x + π/3 still takes every real value. So the shift can be named once and then set aside.
common_mistakes: Expanding cos(x + π/3) and sin(x + π/3) first, which is long and not needed.

steps.label: Apply the maximum and minimum formulas
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The −3 moves BOTH answers down by 3, not just one. The maximum comes out as exactly 0, so f(x) is never positive.
steps.memory_tip: The constant −3 moves both ends down: 3 − 3 = 0 at the top and −3 − 3 = −6 at the bottom.

recall.must_convey: That the maximum is 0 and the minimum is −6, after the constant −3 is added to both ends.
accept: minus three plus three is zero and minus three minus three is minus six
the maximum is zero and the minimum is minus six
the constant shifts both answers down by three
constant ni rendu chotla add cheyyali, zero and minus six
the answers are zero and negative six

steps.why: Adding a constant moves the whole graph up or down without changing its height, so the same constant is added to the maximum and to the minimum.
common_mistakes: Subtracting the 3 from only one of the two answers.
Giving 3 and −3 by dropping the constant.
